name: Donald Trump
role: US President; convened the founding summit
quote: Cuba's government is at the end of the line.

name: Pete Hegseth
role: US Secretary of War; A3C Chairman
quote: Between now and November, we are going to write an A3C campaign plan. We will staff it with our teammates and our members here in the room, and we'll approve it by November.

name: Marco Rubio
quote: The Western Hemisphere is this administration's top strategic priority, and this coalition proves it.

name: Kristi Noem
role: Special Envoy for the Shield of the Americas
quote: This coalition is about giving our partners the tools to defend their own people from cartel violence.

name: Gen. Francis Donovan
quote: A3C members share a common understanding of the threat posed by criminal networks operating in the hemisphere.

name: Abelardo de la Espriella
quote: On my first day in office, Colombia will join the Shield of the Americas.

name: Gustavo Petro
role: Former President of Colombia; sanctioned by US OFAC (Oct 2025)
quote: I will not hand over Colombia's sovereignty in exchange for aid.

name: José Raúl Mulino
role: President of Panama; hosted the August A3C ministerial
quote: Panama's partnership with the United States on canal security is a matter of national and hemispheric interest.

name: Claudia Sheinbaum
quote: Mexico can act on its own — we will not accept US troops on our soil to fight the cartels.

name: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva
quote: Brazil will not designate our domestic criminal organizations as terrorists just to fit into someone else's military framework.

name: Miguel Díaz-Canel
quote: This is a small, reactionary, neocolonial summit — and Cuba will defend itself.

name: Mark Carney
role: Prime Minister of Canada; coalition holdout
quote: Canada's foreign policy will be guided by our own sovereignty, not by pressure from Washington.

name: Javier Milei
quote: Argentina stands with our hemispheric allies against the narco-terrorists who threaten our freedom.

name: José Antonio Kast
quote: Chile's security and economic future are best secured alongside our regional partners.

name: Nayib Bukele
role: President of El Salvador; founding member
quote: We do bad things to bad people — that's the whole point of this coalition.

name: Daniel Noboa
role: President of Ecuador; deepened SOUTHCOM basing cooperation in Esmeraldas and Manta despite the 2025 anti-base referendum
quote: This is not an invasion. This is international collaboration against crime.
